evidence.title: ponytail 5: the lazy senior dev for your AI agent

name: ponytail
summary: Rule set that makes AI coding agents write the least code that works, with review, audit and debt commands.
description: A ruleset/skill for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode and more) that makes them stop at the first rung that holds: skip, reuse, standard library, platform, then the minimum that works. Adds /ponytail-review, /ponytail-audit, /ponytail-debt and /ponytail-gain commands. Benchmarked at 53% less code while correctness and safety checks are kept.
contains: installed in two lines; works with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode and others
benchmark on 39 tasks: 53% fewer lines, 45% fewer output tokens, 26% cheaper, 41% faster
98% of risky logic ships with a test; every reply lists what was skipped and the risk
distributed as @dietrichgebert/ponytail on npm and the DietrichGebert/ponytail repo
